v1: Your agent can build the page. ReviseMy is how you tell it what to change.
v2: Ask for a review. Your agent captures the page and sends you a link.
v3: Drag over anything that needs work, and say why.
v4: Each mark says how much it matters — must fix, nice to have, or keep this.
v5: Mark what to keep, too, so your agent leaves it alone.
v6: A second opinion points out what you might miss. Only your marks count.
v7: Share a guest link, and your client can mark it too. No account needed.
v9: Your agent reads your marks as work. It fixes what you asked for, and leaves what you kept.
v10: Every fix comes back with a before and after.
v11: You compare them and verify each one. Only you can mark a fix verified.
v12: When it looks right, approve. Your agent knows it's done.
v13: Pages, app screens, emails, decks and ads. If it's visual, you can review it.
v14: ReviseMy. Visual feedback for your agent. Free to try at revisemy dot com.
